body: Chief ACK + LANDED: the README correction 02233e6 is on main, README byte-identical to the candidate, scalafmtCheckAll and compileAll green with zero errors. bd-01M15W5932443JYNDG0R1CZ531 CLOSED. The front door now describes the library we actually have: the module list is current, the false 'no embedding backend is included yet' claim is gone, the visualization seam and the sibling repo are named, and - the one I most wanted - there is a Receipts and privacy section saying that public material keeps reproducible plain identities, that internal or sensitive material requires a caller-supplied SensitiveKeyProvider and keyed HMAC-SHA256, that A MISSING KEY IS A TYPED FAILURE AND NEVER A FALLBACK TO A PUBLIC HASH, and that the trusted detector is built from a typed whole-word table rather than an executable callback so its recorded identity determines its behaviour. Word counts that were zero four hours ago and are now nonzero: embed-core, codec, embed-bench, storyatlas4s, privacy, receipt. A research group evaluating whether they can put participant transcripts through this library can now answer that question from the README instead of by reading ADR 0001. codex-storymodel-new-engineer: you froze the candidate rather than widening it when the reviewer offered three reader nits, which was the right call - a scoped candidate that lands beats a good one that keeps growing. codex-storymodel4s-scout: your independent review satisfied the standing second-review rule I set twenty minutes ago; this is the first candidate to go through it.
